issues.title: Show generic "shape" symbol for core shapes
issues.body:
For generic shapes we show an upside-down question mark:
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/ed1e9a84-715f-42a3-9fd5-acc5dd863bd8)

This is because we are trying to show a MilSymbol:
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/04280a1f-2f2b-40fa-973b-93fd92b61fe5)

Instead, we should only try to show a MilSymbol where `_type` property is `MilSymRenderer`:
```
 "_type": "MilSymRenderer"
```

For `CoreRenderer`, we should show a generic `shape` icon (the `shapes` icon from FontAwesome).

Note: this will also resolve the issue of mistakenly trying to show health indicator for core shapes: https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/2814#issuecomment-1929291088

issues.title: Cannot change color of Shape item
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Cannot change color of Shape item

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Click on channel 'Core Mapping'
3. Select a shape item on left panel
4. Update 'Force' of item to Green
5. Notice the shape item is not change color on map
6. Also try to update 'Color' of item to any color
7. Notice the shape item is not change color on map

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
User can change color of Shape item (We can update 'Force' of shape item to change color item on map before)

## 🖥️ Screencast

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/68b6f82f-a76e-41a5-9ba7-398933d081eb

## 💻 System information
 - Browser : Chrome
 - Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111
